message.reasoning:
We need to produce a completed test class for Position.getGrossReturn(BarSeries). Should test behavior: it gets entry and exit price per asset from trades, then calls getGrossReturn(entryPrice, exitPrice). Need to set up Position with entry and exit trades, possibly mock BarSeries and Trades to control getPricePerAsset. But we must not invoke private methods/fields. We can use real Trade objects with a MockBarSeries that returns known close price. Simpler: mock BarSeries and mock Trade objects. However getEntry() and getExit() are public methods returning Trade. We can create a Position using constructor Position(Trade entry, Trade exit, CostModel transactionCostModel, CostModel holdingCostModel). Provide mocks for entry and exit trades that return specific prices when getPricePerAsset(barSeries) called. Also need CostModel objects (ZeroCostModel). Use Mockito to mock Trade. Ensure entry.getPricePerAsset(barSeries) returns entryPrice Num, exit returns exitPrice. Then call position.getGrossReturn(barSeries) and assert equals to position.getGrossReturn(entryPrice, exitPrice) computed via same method? But we can compute expected result manually using known numbers: For a BUY entry and SELL exit, gross return = (exitPrice / entryPrice) - 1? Not sure; but we can just use the position's own getGrossReturn(entryPrice, exitPrice) method to compute expected. That's allowed because it's public. So test that getGrossReturn(barSeries) delegates correctly.

Also test edge cases: when entry or exit price is NaN? Or when position is not closed? The method uses getEntry() and getExit() regardless; if exit not set maybe NullPointer? But we can test closed position.

Implement two tests: one for closed position with mocked prices, another for position where entry and exit are same (should still compute). Use @BeforeEach to set up mocks and position.

Add imports: org.ta4j.core.analysis.cost.ZeroCostModel; org.ta4j.core.num.DoubleNum; org.ta4j.core.num.Num; org.ta4j.core.BarSeries; org.ta4j.core.Trade; etc.
